messages.subject: RE: Project Atlas - SPA mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Our mark-up of the SPA is attached (redline against your v1). The principal points from the Sellers' side: the warranty cap should be 50% of consideration (not 100%); the general claims period should be 18 months; the de minimis and basket should increase to GBP 35k / GBP 500k; and the restrictive covenants should reduce to 2 years. The longstop and the retention mechanics are agreed. Most other changes are drafting.

Marcus

messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Thank you. Our response redline is attached. We can accept the 50% cap and the 18-month period. On the thresholds we have moved to GBP 30k de minimis and GBP 400k basket. On restrictive covenants we have compromised at 30 months. The HMRC VAT enquiry should be covered by a specific indemnity in addition to the tax covenant - we will send wording separately. I think we are close.

James
